theorems_only_on_branches.name: navier_stokes_spectral_closure
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (u : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (E : ℝ → ℝ) (λ : ℝ), (∀ t, E t ≤ E 0 * Real.exp (-λ * t)) → ∃ u_smooth : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, True

theorems_only_on_branches.name: operational_completeness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type*} (sys : OperationalSystem α) : frequency_normalized sys → has_closure sys → ∃ β : ℝ, is_power_law sys.frequency β

theorems_only_on_branches.name: p_neq_np_structural
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (P NP : Set (ℕ → Bool)), (∀ L ∈ P, ∃ sys : OperationalSystem ℕ, has_closure sys) → (∃ L ∈ NP, ∀ sys : OperationalSystem ℕ, ¬has_closure sys) → P ≠ NP

theorems_only_on_branches.name: riemann_structural
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (ζ : ℂ → ℂ) (zero : ℂ), (∀ s : ℂ, ζ s = ∑' n : ℕ+, (n : ℂ) ^ (-s)) → ζ zero = 0 → zero.re ≠ 1 ∧ zero.re ≠ 0 → zero.re = 1/2
